source.author: verg
source.text: hic domus Aeneae cunctis dominabitur oris, et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis.
source.text_original: hic domus Aeneae cunctis dominabitur oris, / et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis.'
source.text_english: Here the house of Aeneas shall rule over all shores, and over their sons’ sons, and those who shall be born from them.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Qui postquam fuerint in gentem unam, et in terra Israel, ac montibus habitaverint, ambulaturi sint in omnibus judiciis Domini, et praecepta illius custodituri; habitaturi autem non in alia terra, sed in ea quam dedit servo suo Jacob, in qua habitaverunt patres eorum, Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, et reliqui sancti, et non solum ipsi habitaturi sint, sed et filii eorum ac nepotes juxta illud Virgilianum: Et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis: habitentque non ad breve tempus, sed in perpetuum.
reuse.text_original: Qui postquam fuerint in gentem unam, et in terra Israel, ac montibus habitaverint, ambulaturi sint in omnibus judiciis Domini, et praecepta illius custodituri; habitaturi autem non in alia terra, sed in ea quam dedit servo suo Jacob, in qua habitaverunt patres eorum, Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, et reliqui sancti, et non solum ipsi habitaturi sint, sed et filii eorum ac nepotes juxta illud Virgilianum: Et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis: habitentque non ad breve tempus, sed in perpetuum.
reuse.text_english: After they have become one nation, and in the land of Israel and on the mountains, they will walk in all the judgments of the Lord and keep his commandments; and they will dwell not in another land, but in the one he gave to his servant Jacob, in which their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the other holy men dwelt; and not only they themselves will dwell there, but also their children and grandchildren, according to that line of Virgil: and their children's children, and those who will be born from them; and they will dwell not for a short time, but forever.
